inputs.text: The Punjab and Haryana High Court ruled that anticipatory bail cannot be cancelled merely because stolen articles were not recovered or the allegations are serious. Justice Sumeet Goel said cancellation requires clear proof that the accused misused their liberty or that supervening circumstances arose. The court dismissed a plea seeking cancellation of pre-arrest bail in a house […] case.

output.main_topic: High Court ruling on cancellation of anticipatory bail
subtopics: Standards for cancelling pre-ar arrest bail
